identityBinding.sourceLocatorSha256: SHA256(exact stable source locator UTF-8); excludes raw bundle hash and payload
identityBinding.payloadFingerprint: SHA256(canonical typed source payload); stored and compared independently from the locator
identityBinding.targetIdentity: The reserved object_identity_id is reused verbatim as the target row's domain-specific CHAR(8) PK
identityBinding.atomicity: Lookup/reservation, payload fingerprint binding, target rows and the complete player graph MUST use one outer transaction through a transaction-scoped identity adapter; the standalone transaction-owning registerCrosswalk call is forbidden inside import
identityBinding.exactReplay: Same namespace+locator+object_type+payload returns the existing target PK with zero INSERT and zero UPDATE. Locator payload drift, target type mismatch, missing target row or PK mismatch fails closed without canonical writes.
identityBinding.concurrency: On duplicate reservation, rollback the whole attempt and re-read the binding; exactly one identity and one target graph may commit
identityBinding.requiredProviderCorrection: A forward migration must persist payload_fingerprint on the crosswalk and a transaction-scoped import binding path must validate object_type before Gate 3 implementation

mappings.ambiguousDefinitionPolicy: Of 5,327 sealed owned occurrences, the current JSON catalog resolves 3,525 uniquely, leaves 87 owned occurrences ambiguous across two exact name+exp+grade signatures, and misses 1,715. Validated main.js CODE_SEED resolves 90 missing occurrences. Historical candidate commit 82a0373d3666b6afa29912ef9441273d20375266, path data/petSweetHomeInfo.json, SHA-256 9aa01517393750942992547223445ad0c77f0351d4a6700c05c36bd10cc7e288 can resolve 326 more only after WBS725 approval, leaving 1,299 occurrences across 789 signatures. WBS725 may resolve those only through an explicitly approved inactive legacy-recovered definition crosswalk with provenance and explicit purchase_price/charm_per_enhancement; otherwise quarantine them as DEFINITION_REFERENCE_MISSING. Quarantine the 87 ambiguous records as DEFINITION_REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS unless WBS725 explicitly collapses identical business definitions while preserving draw multiplicity separately; never choose an arbitrary definition or claim zero-quarantine completeness.

checkpointPolicy: Preflight whole sealed bundle, commit definitions by domain in dependency order, then commit each player's ownership graph atomically. A failed player transaction writes no canonical rows; quarantine evidence is committed separately with the same source fingerprint. Resume skips only committed replay keys with identical fingerprints.
approvedInputPolicy: Synthetic fixtures for Gate 3/4. Gate 5 may use only an explicitly approved, sealed RAW bundle in an isolated disposable database; never write to repository snapshots or an operating database.
